get.summary: Auth mode and environment; the SPA shows the test-mode user switcher when authMode is Test.
The current user.
Documents of a folder (usp_ListDocuments): filter by title (case/accent-insensitive substring), status, sort, page; deleted ones only for their owner and admins.
The nested tree of a version (any status) with numbering; ETag = version stamp.
A node with its ancestors (path).

patch.summary: Owner, draft only: renames a node and/or changes its type (rowVersion required).

delete.summary: Owner, draft only: deletes a node with its whole subtree and contents (usp_DeleteSubtree; ?rowVersion=base64).

post.summary: Owner, draft only: adds a node (with empty content) under a parent at a position (default last).
Owner, draft only: re-parents and/or reorders a node within its version; position = 0-based index (default last).

get.summary: DocHub Content Schema v1: node and mark types, attributes with ranges and values, units, the font list.
A node's content: ?format=json (default), html or both; ETag = version stamp + row version.

put.summary: Owner or content editor, draft only: saves content (rowVersion required); returns the canonicalized JSON. Validation errors carry JSON paths.

get.summary: Contents of several nodes of a version (?nodeIds=1,2,3, at most 200) in the given order, e.g. to render a document; ETag = version stamp + row versions.
History of one node across all versions (with the document's signings as context), newest first.
Document-wide activity (nodes, content, versions, permissions, signatures, comments), newest first; filters are optional.
Diff of a content entry (old → new): blocks with ops, ready-to-render HTML, word counts.
A node's content and header as of a history entry (for viewing and restoring an earlier state).

One call for all section badges: per node change counts, last change, script/after-signing flags and structural changes since a baseline (latestSigned, v:{id}, e:{entryId}, d:{isoDate}), plus removed nodes.
Track changes: the diff of a node's text since a baseline, each insert/delete/format run attributed to the change (user or script + ticket) that made it.
Admin: raw audit.ChangeLog rows of every table, newest first; from/to required (≤ 31 days), other filters optional.
Comment threads of a version (document and/or node comments); includePreviousVersions adds older versions' comments on the same nodes.

post.summary: Owner, editor or approver: comments on the document or a node of a Draft or Signed version, or replies to a top-level comment.

get.summary: Numbers of (not deleted) comments, replies included, on the document and per node of a version (default: the draft, else the current version).

delete.summary: Author or owner: soft-deletes a comment (?rowVersion=base64); a deleted comment with replies stays as "deleted".

post.summary: Owner or approver: resolves a top-level comment.
Owner or approver: reopens a resolved top-level comment.

get.summary: Compares two versions (base=versionId|latestSigned, target=versionId|draft): summary and one merged tree; unchanged branches are left out unless includeUnchanged.
Content diff of one node between two versions (same format as the history diff).

post.summary: Runs ledger reconciliation and the module-integrity check over the configured window (default: last 48 h).

get.summary: Tamper-evidence findings, newest first.
Active users, paged; search = prefix of login, display name or e-mail.
A user by id (also inactive users, e.g. authors in history).
Node types ordered by sort order and name, with their usage counts.

post.summary: Admin: creates a node type (code unique).

get.summary: A node type; usageCount = nodes (any version) using it.

put.summary: Admin: updates a node type (optimistic concurrency via rowVersion); isActive = false deactivates it.

delete.summary: Admin: deletes an unused node type (409 in-use otherwise).

get.summary: Styles for the editor's style dropdown, optionally of one kind.

post.summary: Admin: creates a style (styleId unique; properties validated against the style property schema).

get.summary: CSS generated from the catalog (.ds-style-Heading1 { … }), revalidated with ETag.
A style; usageCount = contents using it.

put.summary: Admin: updates a style (styleId and kind are fixed; rowVersion required); isActive = false deactivates it.

delete.summary: Admin: deletes an unused custom style (?rowVersion=base64); built-in → 409 built-in-style, used → 409 in-use.

get.summary: The whole folder tree, nested and ordered; documentCount = non-deleted documents directly in the folder.
A folder with its breadcrumb path from the root.

delete.summary: Admin: deletes an empty folder (?rowVersion=base64); sub-folders or any documents → 409 in-use.

post.summary: Admin: creates a folder as the last child of the parent (root when parentFolderId is null).
Admin: re-parents and/or reorders a folder; position = 0-based index among the new siblings (default last).
Creates a document (owner = caller) with an empty draft, in one transaction.

get.summary: Document details with its versions and my roles (deleted: owner/admin only, else 404).

put.summary: Owner: renames the document (document-level title; signatures are not affected).

delete.summary: Owner: soft-deletes the document (?rowVersion=base64); versions, draft and signatures stay as they are.

post.summary: Owner or admin: moves the document to another folder (admins also deleted documents).
Owner or admin: restores a deleted document, optionally into another folder.
Owner: new draft = deep copy of the latest signed version (usp_CopyVersionToDraft).

get.summary: Version header; ETag = version stamp (If-None-Match → 304).

delete.summary: Owner: discards the draft (?rowVersion=base64); 409 only-version when there is no signed version.

get.summary: Required approvers, signatures (isValid = bound to the current content), pending approvers.

post.summary: Approver: signs the draft with its current content hash; the last required signature finalizes it (vN).

delete.summary: Approver: withdraws my signature from the draft.

get.summary: The owner and all grants; node grants carry the node title from the draft (else the latest signed version) and whether the node is in the draft.

post.summary: Owner: grants Editor (optionally of one node and its descendants) or Approver to a user.

get.summary: My effective rights (for the UI): editableLogicalNodeIds are node grants expanded to descendants in the draft or current version.

delete.summary: Owner: revokes a grant; revoking an approver withdraws their signature on the draft and re-checks whether it is now fully signed.

TestMode.description: Test mode: id of a seeded, active user (e.g. 2 = alice).
TestMode.name: X-User-Id
